messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: autoscaler-failure in us-west2 - GPU quota hit, queue growing > 2k, 50% request errors. Paging oncall.

alex: seeing a big surge in infer queue for hosted-prod-us-west2. Autoscaler attempting new nodes but GCP returns quota limit errors. Token-level latency spike ~3x.

maria: oncall here. confirming - checking autoscaler logs and GCP quota console. How widespread?

alex: mainly hosted-prod, endpoints serving large-batched audio-to-text and long-context models. We started seeing scale failures at ~08:12 UTC. Error: "quotaExceeded: Quota 'NVIDIA_TESLA_V100' exceeded in region us-west2" in provisioning logs. Queue length: 2,120 by our metrics.

samir: pulling infra logs. autoscaler events: 
```
I0212 08:12:30 autoscaler.go:312] Instance creation failed: quotaExceeded for type gpu
I0212 08:12:31 autoscaler.go:312] Retrying, backoff 30s
I0212 08:13:01 provisioner.go:89] scale-up stalled - 0 new nodes created
```

katie: support report here - customer impact: a subset of hosted customers are seeing 5xx generator errors and timeouts. Estimated affected traffic ~18% of hosted API requests to us-west2. Customers with region pinning affected.

ben: product - can we failover traffic to other regions or fall back to smaller model variants? We need an immediate mitigation plan and a followup for quota increase.

alex: plans: 1) immediate mitigation - route new requests from us-west2 to us-central1 (if capacity) 2) reduce batch sizes / concurrency to lower GPU counts 3) enable fallback to quantized gpt-medium variant for non-sensitive customers 4) open quota increase with GCP and escalate support case. Which is fastest?

maria: I'm going to run the routing change but will do a canary first. @samir can you confirm us-central1 pool headroom? Also start a GCP support case and request emergency quota bump if possible.

samir: checking pool headroom: current gpu utilization in us-central1 is ~62%, spare GPUs = 120. We can absorb ~30% of us-west2 traffic after some warm-up. I'll add a temporary autoscaler policy to allow cross-region routing.

jess-gcp: (from GCP contact) Received offline: emergency quota increases possible but require billing owner approval + support case escalation. Provide project numbers and requested delta. I can fast-track if you open ticket now.

alex: opened support case INC-987654321 (link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/INC-987654321) with details and requested +200 GPUs in us-west2. Adding billing owner in convo.

maria: routing plan: update traffic router rules to reject new sessions to us-west2 and forward to us-central1 for non-pinned customers. Pinned customers remain in us-west2 (they'll see degraded performance). Implementing now.

deploy-bot: start_deploy: update/router/region-failover v1.2 -> in_progress

alex: mitigation step 2: reduce default batch_size from 32 -> 8 for generator endpoints in us-west2 to reduce per-request GPU allocation. Applying config patch to hosted-prod route.

samir: applied autoscaler override: min_nodes=6 -> 3 for us-west2 (to avoid useless create attempts) and enabled cross-region fallback policy. Also set max_concurrent_jobs per node to 6 to reduce OOMs.

katie: I'm drafting a public status note: "We are experiencing capacity-related errors in us-west2 affecting hosted API. Traffic is being routed to other regions where possible. We’re working with our cloud provider to increase GPU quota." Want to include ETA?

ben: ETA: best-case 1-2 hours depending on GCP. Add note: customers with region pinning may remain impacted longer.

jess-gcp: support case updated - GCP asked for project id, requested quota vector and justification. They can provision a temporary regional quota of +150 GPUs within ~60-90 minutes if billing approvals are in place.

maria: handing off to next oncall at 09:30 UTC. Current mitigation: routing change live (50% of new requests redirected), batch size reduction applied to us-west2, autoscaler min reduced to stop noisy retries. Queue length dropped from 2.1k -> 400 after routing.

alex: monitoring logs: 5xx rate down to 6% from 22%. Latency trending down. Will keep quantized model fallback toggled as safety.

samir: opened internal runbook ticket INFRA-4012 for follow-up permanent changes: request regional quota increases, add proactive quota monitoring alarms, add regional warm pools for burst traffic.

katie: support update posted to status.redwood.ai/incidents/us-west2-gpu-capacity (customer-facing note). Added contact for enterprise customers to request manual region migration.

maria: leaving note for oncall: if GCP quota bump is approved, gradually drain failover routing and scale us-west2 back up. If not approved within 90 minutes, escalate to sales/enterprise success to coordinate high-impact customers. Handoff: @samir will own next 30m.

samir: ack. I'll watch the support case and coordinate with Jess for the quota bump. Also will validate node images in us-central1 for any compatibility issues as we ramp.

alex: summary for postmortem: root cause = insufficient regional GPU quota vs surge + autoscaler noise from repeated failed creates. Immediate mitigations = cross-region failover, batch size reduction, fallback to quantized models, reducing autoscaler churn. Action items: quota increase, warm standby pools, quota alarm, improve autoscaler backoff logic, customer communication follow-up.

ben: assigning postmortem: PM-BEN-202 -> postmortem owner Ben. Target draft in 48 hours.

jess-gcp: support case updated: provisional +150 GPUs approved pending billing confirmation. Please confirm project billing contact.

maria: billing owner confirmed via dm. Jess - please proceed with provisional quota.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> partial (impact reduced). Primary mitigation active: cross-region routing.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll keep an eye on model quality after failover. If anything spikes, I'll post here.

samir: closing local action: enabling guardrail to prevent autoscaler from attempting >3 failed creates per 10m. Patch pushed.

katie: customer comms queued for a follow-up update in 1 hour.

deploy-bot: finish_deploy: update/router/region-failover v1.2 -> success

maria: handoff complete. Next oncall please pick up monitoring and escalation for quota case.

alex: last check - queue steady at ~80, 5xx at 3%. Marking thread as active until quota case resolves.

incident-bot: Reminder: create postmortem ticket within 24h and set severity level.
